heading: Valve Body Assembly
text:
AX-10
AUTOMATIC TRANSAXLE (U240E) -- VALVE BODY ASSEMBLY
VALVE BODY ASSEMBLY
ON-VEHICLE REPAIR
1. REMOVE LH ENGINE UNDER COVER
2. REMOVE DRAIN PLUG AND DRAIN ATF
3. REMOVE OIL PAN ANO GASKET
NOTICE:
Some fluid will remain in the oil pan.
Remove the 18 bolts, and carefully remove the oil pan assem­
bly. Discard the gasket.
4. EXAMINE PARTICLES IN OIL PAN
Remove the magnets and use them to collect any steel chips.
Look carefully at the chips and particles in the pan and on the
magnet to anticipate what type of wear you wilt find in the trans­
axle.
Steel (magnetic) ... bearing, gear and plate wear
Brass (non-magnetic) ... bushing wear
5. REMOVE OIL STRAINER
(a) Remove the 3 bolts and oil strainer.m (b) Remove the 0--ring.
N
6. DISCONNECT 5 SHIFT SOLENOID VALVE CONNECþ
TORS
7. REMOVE ATF TEMPERATURE SENSOR
Remove the bolt and lock plate, and remove the ATF tempera­
ture sensor.
8. SEPARATE WIRE HARNESS FROM 2 CLAMPS
D02S34
